composition_notes: Five keyboard layers accumulate, open into distant registers, and withdraw before the final fugue.
The five-layer accumulation is preserved. The opening and withdrawal now share a directed cantabile line, and late suspensions prepare the final fugue.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
